scope: Declared north-Papua New Guinea regional reach from an OSW offshore Vitiaz-downstream approach gate near 147 E, 4.5 S to the 142 E, 2.5 S mooring neighborhood. Excludes passage through Vitiaz Strait itself, upstream Solomon Sea coastal branches, New Britain and St Georges branches, and the cross-equatorial EUC connection. Gates do not establish whole-current origin or termination.
layer: Subsurface thermocline flow. Ueki et al. report a local northwestward core generally at 150â€“250 m near the moorings; the core shoals during El Nino. This local depth support is not a fixed-depth axis assigned along the entire editorial reach. Surface New Guinea Coastal Current remains a separate identity.

source_seasonality_scope: Local undercurrent remains northwestward with boreal summer intensification in the record, with ENSO-related shoaling. Surface current reversal is a separate current. No annual geometry series extracted.
source_sampling_context: Two upward-looking 150-kHz ADCP moorings; changing sampled depth bounds approximately 30–50 to 200–330 m, subsampled at 10 m intervals. Not uniform vertical support along route.
